readme_behavior.teacher: The squeeze scripts train and save pretrained models locally; no checkpoint download is linked.
readme_behavior.patches: RDED_patch.py generates patch initialization from original training data and a classifier.

finding: The official FD2 repository at the audited commit publishes code and three visualization/result figures, but no teacher checkpoints, patch trees, recovered datasets, FKD labels, archives, Git LFS objects, or GitHub release assets.
reproduction_implication: Training a fresh teacher and generating fresh patches is required and is not a deviation from an available official artifact.
